description: Defines a MongoDB-based memory component for chat applications, including class implementations for storing and retrieving messages in MongoDB Atlas.

classes.name: MongoDB_Memory
classes.description: Implements a memory node that stores chat history in MongoDB Atlas.

classes.name: BufferMemoryExtended
classes.description: Extends FlowiseMemory to handle MongoDB operations for chat message storage and retrieval.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the MongoDB memory component with provided node data and options.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from MongoDB for a given session.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Adds new chat messages to MongoDB for a session.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat messages for a session from MongoDB.
